decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extension is used.

Condition : 3 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the west wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - It is considered that this application for the erection of a single storey 
            rear extension to the existing dwellinghouse, because of 
            its position, design and appearance, would be acceptable having due 
            regard for the site characteristics of number 51 Syon Park Gardens 
            and is complementary to the visual amenity of the locality and would 
            not be detrimental to the amenities of adjoining and neighbouring 
            properties.  The development is in accordance with Policies ENV-B 
            1.1 (New Development)  and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the 
             London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003; and is compliant              with Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to existing dwellinghouse
